name: fairy x cleric
source:
The fairy Maybell has guided countless adventuring parties over her career, but very few have been grateful for her wisdom. This one is no exception. So when the party's cleric, Eveline, is separated from the rest, Maybell finally decides that it's time for her revenge. 

Two unappreciated souls who have spent their lives living for others, both granted opportunities to live for themselves. Surely this could only end well. 

Follow Maybell and Eveline on this dark comedy through an ever-shifting magical dungeon, definitely not featuring tentacles.

[From [url=https://plum.itch.io/cleric-x-fairy]itch.io[/url]]
